msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.finalRubric:
itihāsasamuccaye vai
śaṃpāyanayudhiṣṭisaṃvādo nāma dvātriṃśo dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||

support.p: Measurements from the BnF catalogue entry.

lg.l: kathayaṃtaṃ tīrthānāṃ prabhaāvānadbhutaromaśaṃ

dharmatatvajñaṃ pa
ryapṛcchadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||

yo rakṣet prāṇināṃ brahman bhagavan_ śaraṇā
gataṃ ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana ||

ekataḥ kratavā sa
rve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ ||

idam e
va purā devās tulayā samatolayan ||

prāṇirakṣaṇam eneha gauraveṇābhiricya
te ||
atha vodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ ||

iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśī
narasya ca ||
vartamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śivaṃ nṛpaṃ ||

iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto
gniṃ bhūꣻ tatropajagmatuḥ ||
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthaṃ mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ ||

tataḥ śanair upāgamyā śye
narūpī sureśvaraḥ ||
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃḥ provācedaṃ vacas tadā ||
dharmātmānaṃ tvam evehaꣻꣻ rājan mahīkṣitām ||

sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ ka
rma cikīrṣasi ||
bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ ||

kṣamayā kūra
karmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet ||
nopakārapare py evam upakāraparo janaḥ ||

ahite hi
tabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt ||
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ||

ta
d eṣa vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||

mā hiṃsīr llobhato dharmam enam utsṛja bhū
pate ||
kapotakas tu trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgama ||

matsakāśam a
nuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnurayāṃ pagaḥ ||
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bhayāt tava ||

katham a
smadvidhaḥ kuryāt tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitam ||

lobhād dveṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajecchara
ṇāgataṃ ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||

śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā
mahāpātakinām api ||
śaraṇāgatahaṃtṛṇāṃ na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit ||

yathātma
naḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||

tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ
prāṇino budhaiḥ ||
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nnityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||

jaṃtavaḥ parikli
śyaṃte mṛtyos trasyaṃti te pi kaṃ ||
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāso vā krodha eva vā ||
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāhatam api tat tyajet ||

mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhe puru
ṣasyopajāyate ||
yuktaṃ tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣitum ||

yathā hi te jīvita
m ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyam ||

saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano ya
thā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitam ||

tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ
||
yad atra yuktam anyat syān mama śyenāśu tad vada ||

āhārāt sarvabhūtāni
saṃbhavaṃti janeśvara ||
āhāreṇa vivardhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ ||

śakyate nyair vi
nāpy arthai rājan vartayituṃ ciraṃ ||
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ vartayituṃ cirat ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsmān mama prāṇā viśampate ||

vihāya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti pa
nthānam apunarbhavaṃ ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāraṃ mariṣyati ||

rakṣyamāṇaḥ kapo
tatvaṃ bahūn prāṇān haniṣyasi ||
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmān na sa dharmo manaḥ satāṃ |||

avi
rodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||

tasmād virodhe dharmasya saṃciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ
||
yacchrīyas tan mahīpāla kuru dharmavinirṇayam ||

bahukalyāṇasaṃ
yuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama ||
suparṇapakṣirāṭ tvaṃ hi dharma eva na saṃśayaḥ ||

yathā hi
dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahucitraṃ prabāṣase ||

na tetva viditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ
||
nāto bhūyastaro dharmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara ||

prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ
yat pradīyate ||
varam ekasya sattvasya pradattābhayadakṣiṇā ||

na tu viprasahasrasya
gosahasram alaṃkṛtam ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||

tasya dehād vi
muktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||

durlabhaḥ
puruṣo loke sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthaṃ sevā śrutaṃ ta
thā ||
sarvāny abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārghaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ||

catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo
dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ ||
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ ||

api tyājaṃ
rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajam ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyakṣye dīnaṃ kapotakam ||

ya
n mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani ||

bhaveyam aham ārtānāṃ prāṇinām ā
rtināśakaḥ ||
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ ||

prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ
kāmaye bhayanāśanaṃ ||
yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudāhṛtā ||

satyenāne
na bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ ||
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāpi vihaṃgama ||

na
yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmy aham ||

ya eva vihato smākaṃ
dhātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ ||
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryam asty aparair mama ||

śyenāḥ
kapotān khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||

mā rājan sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham ā
ruha ||
nāham ucchāstramārgeṇa kvacid varte vihaṃgama ||

śāstrair evopadi
ṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ sattvaeṣu yad dānam ekasattve ca yadayāparāḥ || 46 ||

sarvasattveṣu yad dānam ekasa
ttve ca yā dayā ||
sarvasattvapradānārtu dayaikāsmād viśiṣyate ||

tena dānāny aśeṣā
ṇi yajñāś ca vividhāḥ kṛtāḥ ||

sarvatīrthābhiṣekāś ca yaḥ kuryān prāṇināṃ dayā
||
vāṃmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

dayādarśitapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vra
jaṃti te ||
gacchatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||

yan na bhūtahitārthāya ta
tpaśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||

ātmavatpari
rakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ ||
prāṇanāṃ vadhyamānānāṃ yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||

sa
yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃm iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||

rājyaṃ śivīnāṃ sumahat prayacchāmi
tava dvija ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ ||

yadi
rājan kapote te sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||

tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni pra
yaccha me ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃsaṃ me bhiyācase ||

etat te
haṃ prayacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ ||

yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaś carād vadati vā na vā
||
mamātipriyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt ||

adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇa
vināśinā ||
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ ||

yadi prāṇyupakā
rāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate ||
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā ||
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara ||

tasmāt kapotena samaṃ pra
yaccha tulayā dhṛtaṃ ||

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhiyāca
se |
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tad vat tava vihaṃgama ||

evam uktvā
svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||

prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabho
||
tyaktvāt tu sukhabhogecchāḥ sarvasattvamukhaiṣiṇaḥ ||

bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādha
vo nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||
dhriyamāṇaḥ sutulayā kapoto vyatiricyate ||

punaś co
tkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādān mahīpatiḥ ||

na vidyate yadā māṃsa kapotena samaṃ
kvacit ||
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayam ||

paraduḥkhāturā ni
tyaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nopekṣaṃte mahānmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api ||

a
tha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe ||

devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papā
ta ha ||
tatas tasya tadā mattvā dharmarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ ||

śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vā
kyam etad abhāṣata ||
iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāṃ svayaṃ ||
jijñāsamāno tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau ||

naitat pūrva nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃ
ti cāpare ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ nṛpa ||

parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇā
nyā prītir abhavat tava ||
prāṇisaṃśayalabdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ ||

parārthaikāṃ
takalyāṇī svaśreyānyaṃ na niṣṭurā ||

tvayy eva kevalā rājan karuṇā karuṇāya
te ||
svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||

tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ ba
ddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa ||
tathā sarvātmanā cāpi doṣeṣv apakṛtaṃ tvayā ||

yathā caivātma
naḥ sthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate ||

akṛtverṣyāṃ ca vṛddheṣu dīnān anavamanya
ca ||
akṛtvā sadṛśe spardhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||

ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇā
nyo naraḥ parirakṣati ||
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāmayato nāvartate punaḥ ||

prāṇair api
tvayā rājan rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ khagaḥ ||

svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā
kathā ||
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodarambharāḥ ||

sa punar jīvitaḥ ślā
ghyo yaḥ parārthaṃ hi jīvati ||
kim atra cittraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||

na hi svadeha
śītāya jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||

sa paraṃ
padam āpnoti parād api hi yat paraṃ ||

paropakāraikadhiyaḥ sukhāya gataniḥspṛhāḥ
||
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||

yat svamāṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ sa
mutkṛttāni pārthiva ||
eṣā te śāśvatī kiīrtir llokān anugāmiṣyati ||
evam uktvā tu ceṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayam ||

rājā ca kratu
m iṣṭvā tu mumude devavaś ciram ||
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ ||
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ ||

viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ ya
śaḥ sarvajanasya durlabhaṃ ||

śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhū
ṣaṇaṃ yayau ||

body.p:
itihāsasamuścaye śivīṃdrāgniśyenakapotīyaṃ saṃvādo
nāma paṇcamo dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
